svg.title: Every organization moves human needs: the Economy of Wisdom quadrant with nine published placements
svg.desc: Four quadrants. Across: amplification A, the fulfillment emitted. Up: filtering F, the deprivation absorbed. Top left Absorber; top right Transmuter, which filters deprivation and amplifies fulfillment; bottom left Extractor, which amplifies deprivation while absorbing fulfillment; bottom right Magnifier, which amplifies both. Nine dots drift in to their published places: UBC, Ai2 (OLMo) and Quebec AI policy as Transmuters; Bill C-34 and Telus data centres as Absorbers; DeepSeek and Ontario AI policy as Magnifiers; Bill C-22 as an Extractor; US tariffs on Canadians as an Extractor on the line with Magnifier.
